marta_cs: Heads up — TideCart asked us to onboard a 7B hybrid reranker for on-prem EU infra. Must support HSM for PHI token sealing, Spanish + German parity, and p95 < 200ms. They're asking for a 30-day pilot tied to their renewal. Can infra + evals confirm what's needed? cc @leo_infra @sam_eval

leo_infra: Short answer: doable but depends on their hardware and network for HSM. We currently support cloud KMS; integrating a customer HSM (PKCS#11) requires a small sidecar and a security checklist. Estimate 39 days to validate connectivity and deploy sidecar once we have access. Need:
- HSM model + vendor docs
- Network ACLs + IP allowlist
- Sample artifact + weights URL

sam_eval: From evals: we'll run privacy leakage, redaction correctness, and catalog regression tests. For multilingual checks we need ~150 queries per language and ground-truth relevance labels. Also request sample PHI tokens and any custom tokenization rules they apply. I'll prepare an eval matrix.

amy_sales: Commercial note: TideCart is negotiating renewal in 6 weeks. They want the pilot to demonstrate reduced false positives in search results. If we can offer a 2-week guaranteed pilot window in EU region, we can push renewal without deeper discounts. I'll coordinate with finance for a short pilot rate. :money_with_wings:

marta_cs: Can we give them a 5-step mini-plan to share with their security team? Need owners and ETA before Wed sync.

leo_infra: Draft 5-step plan:
1) Access & compliance paperwork (customer provides HSM docs, infra contact)
2) Artifact ingestion (model tarball + tokenizer + sample logs)
3) HSM connectivity test (sidecar deploy + PKCS#11 handshake)
4) Eval & perf (sam runs tests, run-bench to validate p95)
5) Pilot & handoff (30 days monitoring, runbook)
ETA: step 3 in 72h after access, full pilot kickoff in ~10 business days assuming no blockers.

Quick dev bench command (example):
```
./run_perf --model tide-7b-quant --seq 192 --batch 1 --hsm pkcs11://hsm-eu-1 --region eu-central-1
```

deploy-bot: Ticket created CS-4721: "TideCart 07B private HSM pilot" https://redwood.example/cs/CS-4721 :white_check_mark:

sam_eval: Also flagging policy team: PHI workloads require a dataflow review and signed DPA. I'll open a policy request and add required artifacts to CS-4721.

amy_sales: I'll add pilot commercial terms to the ticket and draft a short SOW. Marta, can you set the Wed sync for 10:00 CET?

marta_cs: Scheduled Wed 10:00 CET. Owners: @leo_infra (tech lead), @sam_eval (evals), @amy_sales (commercial). Next actions: leo to confirm sidecar image and security checklist (48h), sam to post eval matrix (EOD Fri), amy to attach pilot SOW draft to CS-4721.

leo_infra: Ack. I'll also ping sec infra for PKCS#11 approval and list required firewall rules.

sam_eval: Ack, prepping eval harness and will request labeled queries from the customer via the ticket.

amy_sales: I'll pull pricing for a small reserved pool and propose a pilot SLA.

marta_cs: Thanks team. Adding verbatim customer ask to the ticket for context: "Need PHI-safe reranker with EU hosting, HSM-backed keying and <200ms p95. Pilot ASAP."

(ends)
